findings.evidence: The declaration at line 122 has only `[TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] [T2Space Y]`, `IsCompact C`, `ContinuousOn g C`, and `InjOn g C`; grep shows uses in both `JordanCurve/Basic.lean:166,177` and `JordanCurve/EmptyInterior.lean:178`.
findings.fix: Move the definition to an earlier generic topology module such as `TauCeti/Topology/Homeomorph/Compact.lean`, import it from `JordanCurve/Basic` and `JordanCurve/EmptyInterior`, and remove the declaration from `JordanCurve/Basic`.
findings.issue: `imageHomeomorphOfIsCompactOfContinuousOnOfInjOn` is generic in arbitrary topological spaces and mentions no Jordan-curve notion, so its public placement in `JordanCurve/Basic` misleadingly ties reusable compact-embedding API to Jordan curves.

summary: One newly public, fully generic topology helper is exposed from the Jordan-curve vocabulary file rather than a canonical generic homeomorphism/compactness module.
